mainEntity.name: Can AI sort customer support tickets by urgency, or is that too risky?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI can help summarize tickets, identify likely urgency, detect repeated topics, and prepare a queue for review, but urgency rules should be explicit and tested. Sentiment alone should not decide priority because a calm message can describe a serious account or service problem. Context: Run My AI Biz includes project tracking, reporting, and first-line support examples that can be adapted to operational workflows. These examples still depend on accurate inputs and clear owner review. Key factors: - customer impact - service interruption - financial consequences - deadlines - account status. Practical guidance: Define priority categories with examples and required actions, then test them against historical tickets. Send high-impact or ambiguous cases to a person and audit whether the classification led to the right response.
acceptedAnswer.description: AI can suggest categories and urgency levels, but the rules must be explicit and high-impact or ambiguous cases should receive human review. Test the classifier on historical tickets using customer impact, service disruption, financial consequences, and deadlines—not sentiment alone.
